actor_migration.rule: All new Act II participants are funded by explicit recorded ingress from external Ledger wallets, never added as local unbacked chips. A one-time migration establishes audited external origin balances and debits them on each first entry. Accounting scope expands and exactly records local+external conservation. Do not reset or revive any P4 character; old save IDs preserve original local conservation before/after migration. External ledger is a wider jurisdiction not modeled in P4. Never award player chips at ingress.

entry_rules.slice_victory: prestige entry; +1 Favor from published invitation, no chips
entry_rules.slice_exile: underground entry via a non-chip Ledger petition; choose -1 Favor (floor -3) or surrender one equipped non-Covenant relic; no chips; may enter with no relic via Favor option
entry_rules.fallen: Not directly eligible; use Cinder continuation re-entry route

nodes.rule: Accept +1 Notoriety and a public magical tell in first hand of next table, or decline with no effect; no Lifechips

nodes.name: The Velvet Arena

nodes.name: The Crown Inquest
nodes.success: sole/tied top stack or top-two with net table profit >= max(16,ceil(0.20*entry_stack)); player >=1 chip
